lifecycle.creation_reason: Two independent sub-agents (MT-109 and MT-064) reproduced the same defect from different directions. It is real, deterministic, and belongs to no existing MT scope, so it is captured here per the Operator standing rule that a discovered gap outside the current MT is deferred to a future MT in the same work packet rather than lost.

scope.summary: Converge the FEMS memory-proposal stable request identity between the Rust derivation and migration 0345 so a migrated legacy row and a live retry derive the SAME request_id, restoring retry convergence.
scope.defect_detail: Rust stable_proposal_request_id (src/backend/handshake_core/src/api/memory.rs, around lines 954-981) hashes ELEVEN components and OMITS actor_id, ending with the SHA-256 of source_document_content. Migration 0345_fems_memory_workspace_authority.sql (around lines 105-117) hashes TWELVE: it includes actor_id at position 11 and then repeats document_content_hash at position 12 - a duplicate of position 8, which the MT-064 agent assessed as almost certainly a copy/paste error. A migrated legacy row therefore cannot converge with a live retry.
scope.provenance: VERIFIED BY KERNEL_BUILDER WITH GIT, not assumed. Migration 0345 was added by 892662e0 (2026-07-23), its only commit; git blame attributes every line of the Rust component list to the same commit; and 892662e0 is an ancestor of c7063c24 (MT-064, 2026-07-26). The earlier MT-109 attribution to the MT-064/MT-065 commits was incorrect and has been corrected in MT-109.json. MT-064 and MT-065 inherited this defect.
scope.why_not_folded_into_mt_064: Three concrete reasons recorded by the MT-064 agent and accepted by KERNEL_BUILDER: (1) migration files are not in MT-064 authorized paths; (2) migration 0345 is ALREADY APPLIED so its checksum cannot be edited in place - convergence requires a NEW superseding migration or a re-keying of every live proposal identity, which is a durable-data decision needing its own acceptance criteria; (3) MT-064 canonical confirm receipt now binds to an identity produced by that exact Rust path, so changing the identity underneath it would invalidate a freshly proven green V5 proof.
scope.implementer_assessment_not_a_decision: The MT-064 agent recommends making the RUST 11-component list canonical, on the grounds that it is what live traffic actually produces and that SQL position 12 is a duplicate of position 8 - then shipping a superseding migration that re-derives legacy request_ids. This is an assessment offered for the authority owner, NOT an authorized decision, because it determines how existing durable rows are re-keyed.
acceptance_criteria: AC-112-1: ONE canonical component list and order is chosen and documented, with the rationale recorded in the contract. Rust and SQL derive byte-identical request_ids for the same logical proposal.

AC-112-2: migration 0345 is NOT edited in place (it is already applied and its checksum is immutable). Convergence ships as a NEW superseding migration that re-derives affected legacy rows, with a stated and tested down path.

AC-112-3: the duplicated document_content_hash at SQL position 12 is resolved explicitly - either removed as the copy/paste error it appears to be, or retained with a written justification for why the same hash is intentionally hashed twice.

AC-112-4: legacy_retry_heals_missing_receipt_once_and_converges and migration_0345_old_schema_identity_and_down_up_retry_converge both pass against real PostgreSQL, proving a migrated legacy row and a live retry converge on one identity. Neither test may be weakened or deleted to achieve this.

AC-112-5: the 400-versus-404 question in proposal_missing_provenance_fails_closed is decided explicitly. get_knowledge_rich_document currently returns storage_error(NotFound) -> 404 (memory.rs around line 555) while the test expects 400. It already fails CLOSED, so this is a status-contract decision, not a security hole - fix whichever side is wrong and record why.

AC-112-6: no live proposal identity is silently re-keyed without evidence. Prove, before and after, how many rows change identity and that no proposal is lost, duplicated, or orphaned from its receipt/EventLedger correlation.
proof_targets: PT-112-1: cargo test --lib --features duckdb-flight-recorder,test-utils api::memory:: against real PostgreSQL => the three named tests GREEN with a NONZERO total count.
PT-112-2: a differential proof that the Rust derivation and the SQL derivation produce identical request_ids across a fixture set that includes the actor_id and content-hash edge cases.
PT-112-3: up/down/up migration proof on a WP-scoped database showing convergence survives a full round trip.

hbr_obligations.INT: REQUIRED - identity feeds EventLedger correlation and receipt recovery.
hbr_obligations.PRIV: REQUIRED - actor_id participates in (or is deliberately excluded from) the identity; the decision must not weaken attribution.
hbr_obligations.MAN: REQUIRED if any operator- or model-visible contract changes.
